messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, {04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}What do
you like better,{01 00 00 05 00} fossils or
fruit pie?
{07 16 00}Tough question, right?
Yeah, I like 'em both,
{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}But {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}
fossils are more majestic
than any stupid pie!
{07 00 00}Someday I'll find one and
set that baby up in my
room, {01 00 00 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii, {04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}Mis sulle
rohkem meeldib,{01 00 00 05 00} fossiil või
puuviljapirukas?
{07 16 00}Raske küsimus, eks?
Jah, mõlemad meeldivad,
{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Aga {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}
fossiilid on uhkemad
kui ükski rumal pirukas!
{07 00 00}Kunagi leian ühe ja
panen selle oma
tuppa, {01 00 00 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Lately, {01 00 00 05 00}I've been hunting{01 00 00 05 00}
for fossilized
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} bits.
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Not that I care if I find
'em or not,{07 00 00} {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 15 00}You see, I hate how I 
never seem to find stuff 
I'm really looking for!
{07 19 00}But if I pretend not to
care, {01 00 00 05 00}I'll probably find it
right away!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Viimasel ajal, {01 00 00 05 00}olen otsinud{01 00 00 05 00}
fossiliseerunud
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} tükke.
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Mitte et ma hooliks, kas
leian või mitte,{07 00 00} {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 15 00}Näed, ma vihkan seda, et
ma ei leia kunagi asju,
mida tõesti otsin!
{07 19 00}Aga kui ma teesklen, et ei
hooli, {01 00 00 05 00}leian ma selle
ilmselt kohe!
